mapper.select: SELECT next_sequence FROM arte_ai_invocation WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_invocation SET next_sequence=#{nextSequence} WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
mapper.select: SELECT written_bytes FROM arte_ai_invocation WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_invocation SET written_bytes=written_bytes+#{bytes} WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot FROM arte_ai_event WHERE invocation_key=#{invocationKey} AND sequence_no>#{afterSequence} ORDER BY sequence_no LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT retained_after FROM arte_ai_invocation WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM arte_ai_event WHERE invocation_key=#{invocationKey} AND sequence_no<=#{throughSequence}
mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_invocation SET retained_after=#{retainedAfter} WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
